facts.en: Completed a research administration diploma at Fictional Alder Prism Institute in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构桤棱学院完成研究行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Attended an internal records-retention briefing in 2024-02; it did not qualify the candidate as an ethics reviewer.
facts.zh: 参加 2024-02 内部记录保留简报培训；不授予伦理审阅资格。

facts.en: Office records intern at Fictional Horizon Cabinet, 2022-08 to 2023-01.
facts.zh: 2022-08 至 2023-01 在虚构地平柜机构任办公室记录实习生。

facts.en: Research team administrator at Fictional Horizon Cabinet, 2023-02 to 2024-10.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2024-10 在虚构地平柜机构任研究团队行政专员。

facts.en: Research administration assistant at Fictional Horizon Cabinet, 2024-11 to 2026-09; the title changed within the same organization.
facts.zh: 2024-11 至 2026-09 在虚构地平柜机构任研究行政助理；职称在同一机构内变化。

facts.en: The internship involved filing office purchase records, not collecting research data.
facts.zh: 实习涉及归档办公室采购记录，并非收集研究数据。

facts.en: Tracks proposal deadlines, document versions, and investigator-requested meeting dates.
facts.zh: 跟踪提案截止日期、文档版本及研究负责人要求的会议日期。

facts.en: Assembles submission folders using the principal investigator-approved checklist; investigators retain scientific and approval responsibility.
facts.zh: 使用首席研究负责人批准的核对表整理提交文件夹；科学及审批责任由研究负责人保留。

facts.en: Maintains administrative records for 4 active study proposals in 2026-09; 7 proposals were tracked during the 2025-03 deadline peak.
facts.zh: 2026-09 为 4 项活跃研究提案维护行政记录；2025-03 截止高峰期间跟踪 7 项提案。

facts.en: Co-developed a proposal completeness tracker with a senior administrator in 2025-01.
facts.zh: 2025-01 与高级行政专员共同开发提案完整度跟踪表。

facts.en: Personally added required-file fields and document version links; the senior administrator approved checklist categories.
facts.zh: 个人添加必需文件字段及文档版本链接；核对表类别由高级行政专员批准。

facts.en: During the 2025-04 check, 5 of 6 sampled proposal folders included all checklist documents; this did not measure funding success.
facts.zh: 在 2025-04 检查中，抽样 6 个提案文件夹有 5 个包含全部核对表文档；此并不衡量获资助成功率。

facts.en: Rolled the approved tracker out to the administrative team in 2025-02 after senior administrator review.
facts.zh: 经高级行政专员审核后，于 2025-02 将获批跟踪表推广至行政团队。

facts.en: Drafted a conference travel checklist in 2026-06; it had not been approved by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-06 起草会议差旅核对表；截至 2026-09 尚未获批。

facts.en: Uses calendar tools, spreadsheet deadlines, and permission-controlled document folders.
facts.zh: 使用日历工具、电子表格截止日期及权限受控文档文件夹。

facts.en: Routes scientific questions to investigators and retains an administrative decision log.
facts.zh: 将科学问题转交研究负责人，并保留行政决策日志。

facts.en: In the retention briefing, sorted invented document examples by an approved retention schedule; no real participant records were used.
facts.zh: 在记录保留简报培训中，按批准的保留计划分类虚构文档示例；未使用真实参与者记录。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Lantern Museum during 2024-12 weekends while remaining employed full-time.
facts.zh: 2024-12 周末在虚构灯笼博物馆做志愿者，同时保持全职任职。

facts.en: Museum duties involved counting display stands, not conducting academic research.
facts.zh: 博物馆职责涉及清点展示架，而非开展学术研究。

facts.en: Created a personal catalogue of 29 imaginary shell drawings in 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2023-06 为 29 幅假想贝壳画作制作个人目录。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching shells and playing cooperative board games.
facts.zh: 爱好描绘贝壳及玩合作类桌游。

facts.en: No grant award, ethics approval authority, principal-investigator role, or scientific authorship is claimed.
facts.zh: 不声称获得科研资助、伦理审批权限、首席研究负责人角色或科学著作署名。
